dictionary.intro: Simplified views are ready for statistics (season, split dates, filters); advanced tables are the app's raw data. Tap a column to insert it into the query.

objects.v_settings: Constants of the query: season start month, current date and time, current season.
objects.v_seasons: One row per season, from the first outing to today, with its start and end dates.
objects.v_days: The calendar day by day since the first outing, to count days without outings too.
objects.v_boats: One row per boat, with its class (1x, 2-, 4x+…), seats and default configuration.
objects.v_rowers: One row per rower, with status, gender, age category and outings. Contact details can never be read.
objects.v_routes: One row per route, with its distance.
objects.v_outing_types: Outing types (training, regatta, tour…), built in or added by the club.
objects.v_outings: One row per outing: boat, boat class, route, dates split for grouping (month, week, day, hour), season, duration, distance and crew. The most useful view.
objects.v_outing_rowers: One row per rower per outing: to count participations, active rowers or kilometers per person.
objects.v_incidents: One row per reported incident, with the boat and the season.
objects.v_damages: One row per damage, with its severity, repair time and cost.
objects.boat: Boats table, as stored by the app.
objects.boat_configuration: Boat configurations: seats, sculling or sweep, coxed or not.
objects.rower: Rowers table. Names and birth date are personal; contact details are always empty.
objects.outing: Outings table, with raw dates and without the views' computed columns.
objects.outing_crew: Crew of each outing: one rower or cox per row.
objects.rower_group_member: Which rowers belong to which group.

hints.season: Start year of the season: 2025 = season 2025-2026. Write :season to follow the season chosen at the top.
hints.season_week: Week counted from the season start (1 to 53), to compare two seasons.
hints.start_month_key: Month as YYYY-MM, handy to group by month.
hints.start_weekday: Day of the week: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday.
hints.start_week: Date of the Monday of the week.
hints.counts_in_stats: 0 when the boat (or rower) is excluded from statistics: filter with counts_in_stats = 1.
hints.has_start_time: 0 for outings imported without a time (efa2): leave them out of per-hour statistics.
hints.is_multi_day: 1 when the outing ends on another day (tour).
hints.duration_min: Duration in minutes; empty for an ongoing outing.
hints.distance_m: Recorded distance, else the route's; empty when unknown.
hints.distance_km: Recorded distance, else the route's; empty when unknown.
hints.distance_source: recorded = entered on return, route = distance of the route.
hints.is_ongoing: 1 for a boat still on the water.
hints.rower_code: Stable code R-XXXXXXXX that replaces the name when names are hidden.
hints.display_name: First and last name; empty when names are hidden (AI assistant in pseudonymized mode).
hints.return_delay_min: Actual return minus planned return, in minutes; negative = early.
hints.crew_size: Number of people on board, cox included.
hints.age_in_year: Age reached in the year of the outing.
hints.end_date: Day after the last day (excluded): write start_date < end_date.
hints.cutoff_date: End of the season, or tomorrow when the season is ongoing.
hints.outing_count: All outings of the rower, in any role.
hints.is_coached: 1 when the outing was coached; empty when not filled in.
hints.boat_class: Boat class in the usual notation: 1x, 2x, 2-, 4x+, 8+…
hints.days_open: Days from the report to the repair (or today).

keyFilters.season: the season chosen at the top

examples.title: Examples
examples.firstStepsIntro: The Explorer queries the club's data in SQL, read-only: you can't break anything.

steps.1: Start from an example below, or from a report ("View SQL query").
steps.2: Change it: tap a column in the Dictionary to insert it; :season follows the season chosen at the top.
steps.3: Run it, pick the chart, then save it or pin it to the dashboard.

examples.aiHint: Not comfortable with SQL? Describe what you want in "Ask the AI" at the top.

descriptions.outingsByMonth: Count outings and group them by month (GROUP BY).
descriptions.topBoats: Rank the boats and keep the top 10 (ORDER BY, LIMIT).
descriptions.boatClasses: Split the outings by boat type, as a pie chart.
descriptions.attendance: Cross day and start hour, as a heat map.
descriptions.kmPerRower: Add up each rower's kilometers (SUM, ROUND).
descriptions.seasons: Compare the seasons with each other, without :season.
descriptions.boatsNotUsed: Join two views and keep the boats with no outing (LEFT JOIN, HAVING).
descriptions.lateReturns: Filter on a measure: back more than 15 min after the expected time.
descriptions.busiestDays: Group by date and rank the days (ORDER BY … DESC).

history.title: Query history
history.empty: No query run on this computer yet.
history.intro: The latest queries run on this computer. Tap one to open it again as a new query.

functions.NULLIF: Empty when both values are equal: NULLIF(x, '').
functions.IFNULL: Replacement value when the first one is empty.
functions.DATE: Date part of a date and time: DATE(start_at).
functions.JULIANDAY: Julian day: the difference of two gives a gap in days.
functions.GROUP_CONCAT: Joins the values of a group into one text.

errors.tableMissing: The view or table "{{name}}" doesn't exist.
errors.columnMissingNoFrom: Column "{{name}}" doesn't exist: add the view that has it after FROM.
errors.typo: "{{word}}" is not an SQL word: did you mean {{keyword}}?
errors.syntaxNear: Syntax error just before "{{token}}": check the word before it (missing or extra comma, parenthesis or keyword).
errors.incomplete: The query ends too early: a closing parenthesis or the end of a condition may be missing.
errors.ambiguous: Column "{{name}}" exists in several views: say which one, e.g. o.{{name}}.
errors.aggregate: COUNT, SUM, AVG… can't go in WHERE: put this condition in HAVING, after GROUP BY.
errors.syntaxAt: Error in the query, line {{line}}, column {{column}}.
errors.internal: Unexpected error in the statistics engine.
errors.readOnly: Statistics only read data: DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT… are refused and nothing was changed. To fix an outing or a rower, use the Logbook or Management.
errors.missingParam: Give :{{name}} a value in "Parameters", under the editor.
errors.timeout: Stopped after {{seconds}} s, the limit of this computer's {{profile}} profile.

timeoutTips.1: Filter on a season (season = :season) or a period.
timeoutTips.2: Avoid SELECT * on v_outing_rowers: pick the columns.
timeoutTips.3: A WITH RECURSIVE query needs a stop condition (WHERE i < 100).
